advice.en: DANGER: Do not go to sea today.

data_quality.note_en: Wave models mask shallow water. Cells flagged wave_estimated take their wave height from the nearest cell with data (up to 30 km), which tends to over-warn rather than under-warn.

model.note_so: Ma jiro model tababaran weli. Tirradan waxay ka timid cagaaran iyo kala duwanaanta heerkulka ee la cabbiray - maaha saadaal.
model.note_en: No trained model yet. This index is measured chlorophyll and temperature-front strength, ranked across the grid - not a validated prediction.

reach.note_en: Zones cover only water an open boat can work in a day trip. Cells beyond that are shown but never ranked or recommended.
